thread:
nina: Heads-up, onboarding onyxpack-v1 (int8) on staging. Quick smoke: ja->en and zh->en BLEU dips vs fp16 and a few detok token-splitting oddities around U+202F and ZWSP. Also one user sample shows parentheses flipping when Arabic is inside. Repro and notes below.

hiro: Can you paste a tiny repro and the tokenizer/detok output?

nina: Repro I used: 
```
# samples.txt
ja: \u3053\u3093\u306b\u3061\u306f\u3002
zh: \u4eca\u65e5\u306e\u66f2\u304c\u3044\u308b\u3002
mix: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645(\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd)"
# command
python infra/eval/run_eval.py --artifact /artifacts/onyxpack-v1/int8 --tokenize-only --input samples.txt --out tok.txt
```

nina: tok.txt excerpt (showing visible separators):

"\u3053\u3093\u306b\u3061\u306f" "\u3002"
"\u4eca\u65e5\u306e\u66f2" "\u304c" "\u3044\u308b" "\u3002"
"\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645" "\\u202F(" "\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd" ")"

matt: The literal \\u202F between RTL token and paren stands out. Does the fp16 artifact canonicalize that away?

amelia: I ran a small eval on zhen dev set: fp16 BLEU=28.7, int8 artifact BLEU=25.9 on same config. Swapping int8 model to use fp16 tokenizer during eval recovered BLEU to 28.4. So tokenizer/detok mismatch is the main vector.

hiro: Which packager/builder produced the int8 artifact? Any change in tokenizer packager version?

nina: int8 build id int8-20260502-09 built by builder=packer-4. fp16 was built earlier with packer-3. Changelog for packer-4 mentions "preserve narrow spaces by default for mixed-direction blocks".

matt: That could explain U+202F behavior. Any detok bidi flags different between artifacts?

amelia: Yes — fp16 artifact had PRESERVE_BIDI=true in packaging env; int8 packer default set PRESERVE_BIDI=false. I grepped detok code: when preserve_bidi=false we call unicode_bidi_reorder() which can change stored order, not just rendering.

ci-bot: Created issue ML-2301 "onyxpack-v1 int8 tokenizer/detok parity -> BLEU regression" with labels triage, tokenizer, quant.

hiro: Practical next steps: 1) rebuild int8 artifact but inject fp16 normalizer (map U+202F->space, remove ZWSP) and set PRESERVE_BIDI=true in packer env; 2) add artifact lint that diffs normalizer.json between artifacts and fails on unexpected rules; 3) add micro eval (mixedscript suite) as gate for quant onboarding.

nina: I patched the int8 artifact locally by copying fp16 normalizer.json into the int8 artifact and re-running tokenize-only + eval on small zhen sample. Result: BLEU=28.5 (close to fp16). Also fixed the paren flip sample — stored string now has stable ordering, no mirrored paren.

matt: Good. We should also track why packer-4 default changed. File a follow-up with infra-packaging. If packer is updated org-wide, we need a release note for tokenizer maintainers.

amelia: Agreed. I'll add a postmortem note in ML-2301 detailing U+200B (ZWSP) and U+202F handling rationale for our locales and the PRESERVE_BIDI semantics.

ops-bot: Tagged ML-2301 as blocker-for-int8-onboard and assigned to packaging-team.

hiro: One more ask: add a unit test in tokenizer-inspect that runs a small mixedscript sample and asserts tokenization parity between fp16 and quant artifacts (or at least no insertion of narrow spaces). Helps catch future silent packager changes.

nina: Will implement tests and the patched packer config. ETA for patched int8 artifact rollout to staging ~40m. Will post final numbers after full e2e smoke. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
